{{Quote|Sir, they've taken out our turbolasers.|The officer, to Armitage Hux|<ref name="TFA" />}}
A [[human]] '''officer''' served the [[First Order]] during its [[Cold War|conflict]] with the [[Resistance]]. They were stationed in the control room of the [[bridge]] of the [[Resurgent-class Star Destroyer|''Resurgent''-class Star Destroyer]] ''[[Finalizer]]'' when [[Finn|FN-2187]] and the [[Resistance pilot]] [[Poe Dameron]] carried out an [[Escape from the Finalizer|escape]] from the vessel. During the escape, the [[First Order officer|officer]] informed [[General]] [[Armitage Hux]] that Dameron and FN-2187 had taken out the [[Star Destroyer]]'s [[turbolaser]]s. The [[Aurebesh]] [[Rank insignia of the First Order|cuff-title]] on their left sleeve said "[[Hal (Imperial officer)|Hal]],"<ref name="TFA" /> designating them as a [[squad leader]].<ref name="TFA VD">''[[Star Wars: The Force Awakens: The Visual Dictionary]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Despite having a speaking line and appearing in close-up, the character was portrayed by an uncredited actor in [[Star Wars: Episode VII The Force Awakens|''Star Wars'': Episode VII ''The Force Awakens'']].<ref name="TFA" />
